top_choice_rationale: P002 honours a new, tunable regime of quantum matter: the Bistritzer-MacDonald flat-band prediction at a magic angle followed by the experimental discovery of correlated insulating and superconducting states, reproduced across many laboratories and device geometries. Restricted to what is secure (flat bands plus the experimental discovery, no claim about pairing mechanism or that theory predicted the correlated phases), it rests on established results. I concede that maturity (about eight years) and experimental credit (Dean, Young, Yacoby, Efetov, Yazdani outside the three names) are weaker than for P001, but I weigh scientific originality and scope higher. P001 is a mature, cleanly attributed second choice, and any award is preferable to no award.
